context: Per site, decide whether the field is the SAME statistic as the core one or a deliberately different one. Same -> migrate onto percentile_ms/sample_stdev_ms and disclose the numeric delta, exactly as PR #1551 did. Different -> rename the field so two definitions never share a name, and document why. result_capture.py is the one that matters most because it reaches published result bundles; its stdev is population where core's is sample, which is a definitional difference, not a rounding one. Widen the verification grep beyond mcp+cli so the rung stops certifying a claim it does not check.
description: Phase 1 adversarial review (2026-08-04) of merged PRs #1548-#1551 found one-engine-unify-statistics incomplete, and its rung 1 overclaiming: the grep covers only benchbox/mcp and benchbox/cli while its expected text asserts 'Statistics helpers exist only in benchbox/core'. Three implementations survive. (1) benchbox/platforms/base/result_capture.py::_build_latency_stats and _build_numeric_stats compute p90/p95/p99 by linear interpolation and stdev via statistics.pstdev (POPULATION, not sample), and this path feeds result bundles -- so one bundle can carry two definitions of the same field name. Measured on the 22 TPC-H fixture timings: core p95 200.0ms vs result_capture p95 199.0ms; core sample stdev 76.74 vs capture population stdev 74.97. (2) benchbox/core/vector_search/metrics.py::_percentile, linear interpolation. (3) benchbox/experimental/load_testing/analyzer.py::_percentile, floor-index. All three were out of scope for one-engine-unify-statistics (do_not_modify benchbox/platforms/; only_modify covered benchbox/core/results/ only).

preserves.behavior: Published result bundle field NAMES are unchanged; any field whose definition changes is listed with its numeric delta.
benchbox.core.results.metrics stays the canonical implementation; no new percentile definition is introduced.

verifications.description: No percentile or stddev helper survives outside benchbox/core/results
verifications.expected: Exits 1 on the unfixed tree (three definitions exist today); exits 0 only once each is migrated or renamed.

verifications.description: Latency stats agree with the core definition
verifications.expected: Result-capture latency percentiles match percentile_ms and its stdev matches sample_stdev_ms, or the differing fields are renamed and tested as such.
